answer_1.quote: We select a large and diverse collection of few-shot tasks from , covering various types including classification, question answering and generation.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated outputs in text-to-text format tasks such as summarization and paraphrase generation.

answer_2.quote: We use average relative gain (ARG) as the main evaluation metric. We first calculate relative gain (RG) for each target task, i.e., relative performance improvement before and after applying the upstream (meta or multi-task) learning on the source tasks. Then we average the relative gains of all target tasks to obtain the final result which indicates the overall performance improvement.
